D.t: Marcy Kaptur leads by 1.0 in the forecast and wins 56% of simulations. The cushion is about 3,309 votes; a one point swing is about 1,591 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +6.9 and D +9.1. A normal polling error decides it.
$1.2M cash against $807K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
